name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: A statement that lights up word by word as it scrolls through the screen.
docs: For the one sentence a page is built around. Screen readers read the sentence whole. Give it room above and below, so the words have scroll to light up in. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.
